Title: Public Preview: Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Flexible Server network monitoring metrics

Body.Content:
We are excited to announce the release of new network monitoring metrics in Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Flexible Server. With these enhancements, you can now gain deeper insights into network activities at the virtual machine level, helping you effectively identify and address network-related issues more quickly. These new metrics—including TCP Connection Backlog and Postmaster Process CPU Usage—provide actionable data that enhances the stability and reliability of your services. By enabling these features, you can be better equipped to prevent potential service outages and improve overall performance. We encourage you to enable these metrics and start monitoring today to help ensure your applications run smoothly and efficiently.  

 

Learn more.
